streams.inputs: the Trait Descriptive Adjectives census list (Condon, Coughlin and Weston 2022); source_ref prefix tda:
streams.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose file's `source` names the TDA list, or a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:censuses` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

streams.inputs: Allport and Odbert's 1936 word list as digitised on OSF; source_ref prefix allport:
streams.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose file's `source` names Allport and Odbert's list (not Allport and Ross's religious orientation scale, which extrinsic_allport and intrinsic_allport name), or a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:censuses` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

streams.inputs: Roget's Thesaurus heads chosen as the gap heads of the coverage report, which is built from corpus labels (roget/harvest.py select_heads); the harvest within a head is independent
streams.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose file's `source` names Roget, or a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:roget` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one
streams.note: no `recover` command: generator-side hiding not built

streams.inputs: WordNet's (OEWN) trait-noun closure: adjectives under the trait synsets (no partner_hint)
streams.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose file's `source` names OEWN or WordNet, or a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:wn_clusters` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

streams.inputs: WordNet antonyms of corpus labels with no partner file (partner_hint set)
streams.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose queue entry carries `source:wn_clusters`, or whose file's `source` names OEWN

streams.inputs: the International Personality Item Pool's items, clustered and named blind (no corpus label shown)
streams.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose file's `source` names the IPIP, or a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:ipip` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

streams.inputs: a base model's continuations of list and gloss frames (base_model/prompts.py names no corpus trait)
streams.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:base_model` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

streams.inputs: AI-disposition phrases extracted from alignment papers, incident lists and usage policies
streams.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:alignment_sweep` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one
streams.note: its occasions are its own runs (the papers run and variant B), tested on their own

streams.inputs: the antonym check's candidate antonyms of corpus traits (generate_antonyms.py answers)
streams.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:antonym_check` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

streams.inputs: names the states pass proposed for rows M1 held as states; source_ref is the source row's key
streams.exclusion_rule: attributed to the source row's generator (pre-registered question 6)
